    import sys
    import re

        with urllib.request.urlopen('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/michael-lazar/rtv/master/rtv/__init__.py') as f:
            content = f.read().decode('utf-8')
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print('Error:', e.code, e.reason)
        return
